The '''Bursa Leader''' commanded a clan of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3000 BBY]]. The [[Gungan]] [[Marsune]] encountered the leader, who had been recently injured and the clan as he prepared for the [[Raid on Spearhead]]. Marsune arranged for a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] to heal the leader, securing the bursa clan's allegiance for the battle.<ref name="GB" />
